title: increment-sequence
description: A family U = (u_tau) of C-natural predication valuations indexed by a settling bound, supplying the new evidence introduced at each settling step; the input data that drives a closure-driven spatiotemporal knowledge presheaf.

bound.description: the settling bound lambda that indexes the family

increments.description: the family (u_tau) for tau < lambda; each entry is the predication valuation supplying the evidence introduced at settling step tau

natural.description: each u_tau is C-natural: f*(u_tau(p)) = u_tau(q) for every morphism f : q -> p in the predicate category C
